newest_result.name: exact target-to-rootless bridge and constructive integral hyperbolic stabilization
newest_result.statement: The corrected dense and intrinsic-boundary searches contain 30 exact total-intersection-two P1/P2 pairs in 71,302,414 section tests. Exhausting 9,456,854 subsequent P3 candidates found no complete Gram triple. A sampled pair-first extension at p=17,19,23 performed 88,931,043 further section tests and exhaustively checked 5,315,813 P3 candidates after its three eligible pairs, again with zero P3. The full incidence reduces to a 61-by-62 Jacobian and six P3 remainder equations. Independently, the target essential lattice has the same cyclic discriminant form and X(6,79) Clifford fingerprint as the determinant-948 Shimura landscape. Actions run 32673843229 exactly replayed the seven public Kneser steps and all rational parent-child Gram identities, including the composed basis identity. Run 32674002260 serialized 4,990 successful moves among 4,992 attempted lines and found no common cross-side theta fingerprint or exact bridge.
